description:
Spec 097 / ADR-035 Amendment C8. Returns the usage-tiered price schedule
for paid calls. Prices are integer strings of USDC atomic units
(6 decimals). Rows are `{tier, from, to, price_atomic}`; `to` is null for
the open tier. `anonymous` is the price a call without an API key pays.
The schedule is the compiled-in default unless a validated override is held
in KV (one KV read, no database read); `schedule_source` says which.
`band` is the floor and ceiling every tier price sits inside.
`schedule_hash` is the sha256 hex of the RFC 8785 canonical schedule, so a
consumer can tell when prices change.

`counting_rule`: the tier is set by settled paid calls per API key in the
current UTC calendar month; a call without a key pays the top-tier price;
a call counts only after a successful settle; the 402 response quotes the
price of the caller's next call. `consistency_note`: the count is kept in
KV, which is eventually consistent, so a tier boundary can drift by a few
calls.

Freshness: `observed_at` is the response time, `valid_until` is 24 hours
later, `stale_if_error` is 86400 seconds.
Add `?receipt=true` for a signed Receipt v1.0 over the same payload.

receipt.description: When true, attach a signed Receipt v1.0 committed to the transparency log. Additive — a signing failure never costs you the observation (ADR-014).

name: get_pricing
